sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United travel to Telford Town on Saturday seeking to bounce back from consecutive defeats. Telford are struggling at the foot of the table with just one win from 14 games, making this an opportunity for Sandbach to return to winning ways despite their recent dip in form.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host AFC Bridgnorth in a fixture between two strong sides near the top of the table—Stafford recent form shows steady consistency with two wins and four draws, while Bridgnorth remain unbeaten in their last six league matches. Third-placed Eccleshall face New Mills at home in another competitive encounter. Wolverhampton Casuals, currently fourth and in excellent form with four consecutive wins, travel to face struggling Foley Meir. Bilston Town, sixth and also in strong form, host Cheadle Heath Nomads at home on Saturday. Mid-table Barnton entertain Market Drayton Town, while Brereton Social face Shawbury United—both sides in the lower reaches of the table. Allscott Heath play host to Wednesfield Community in another bottom-half clash. Alsager Town, near the foot of the division and winless for several games, visit Widnes Town, who are also struggling with just one win in their last five. Crewe host Dawley Town in a fixture between sides attempting to climb away from the relegation zone. Finally, on Tuesday evening, Widnes Town travel to face AFC Bridgnorth in a rearranged fixture.
